messages:
maria: Hey team, heads up — onboarding sample app is spiking 429s when users hit the paginated embeds flow. Repro: sign up -> run sampleapp with prefetch=3 -> immediate navigator jumps -> 429s.

alex: ugh. any logs? is it TTL/auth related or pure rate?

maria: logs show bursts of concurrent requests from the sample sdk during initial sync. also we see a lot of `auth refresh` churn (sts token swap) around the same time. so two things: concurrency window + token handshake.

sam: sounds like a classic backpressure+auth-stampede. sample app currently prefetches next 3 pages in parallel with no jitter. Can you paste the client config?

jordan: also: Go SDK behaves differently — it gates prefetch with a semaphore by default. JS SDK historically didn't. SDK parity gap?

maria: current config in sampleapp: `prefetchPages: 3, concurrency: 8, retry: { maxRetries: 2 }`. No token-refresh dedupe.

alex: quick mitigation: reduce concurrency on onboarding flow to 2 and add exponential jitter to prefetch. In JS, `await sleep(Math.random() * 200)` between prefetched requests helps.

sam: we should also debounce token refresh. If multiple requests see 401, only one should perform the STS refresh and others wait on the promise. That's what our Go SDK does.

maria: I can patch sampleapp with a simple dedupe w/ a global `refreshPromise`. Want me to open a PR?

jordan: +1. Also add a warning in the quickstart docs about startup prefetching. Many users run sampleapp unthrottled in CI which trips quotas.

alex: For longer-term: add client-side circuit breaker in JS SDK with a short open window on 429s and auto-reduce prefetch. Could be opt-in for onboarding sample.

sam: Agree. File an RFC outlining: (1) token refresh dedupe API, (2) default concurrency caps for sampleapps, (3) parity test to ensure SDKs gate prefetch similarly.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/421 — includes dedupe + `prefetch: { maxParallel: 2, jitterMs: 150 }` and doc note.

ci-bot: deploy-check: sampleapp/unit-tests passed for PR 421 (:white_check_mark:)

alex: Nice. For immediate telemetry, can we add a metric tag `onboard.prefetch_concurrency` so ops can alert if startup 429s > 2%?

sam: I'll add a dashboard tile and a simple alert. Also adding a tiny e2e that runs onboarding flow with throttling enabled to catch regressions.

maria: action items: maria -> merge PR, alex -> add metric/tag, sam -> add e2e + alert, jordan -> docs blurb.

jordan: I'll also add a short note in the SDK parity checklist: `prefetch gating` and `refresh dedupe` as items.

maria: thanks all. leaving this thread open until PR is merged and alert is up. :+1:
